clips.send: A friend sends it to the one who babies their car but ignores their own body completely - the shame of double standards.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's own comparison: he takes his car in for an oil and filter change because things build up inside the engine over time.

He does the same for his body: whole-food supplements made from real, dehydrated food instead of extracts, plus fasting and colon cleanses, to clear out what builds up.

His last word on health: he took life lightly and laughed a lot, because laughing, he says, is really the best medicine.

What's one habit you started years ago and never stopped?

clips.send: A woman sends it to the friend who swears by her lotion, and to any guy on testosterone therapy who still feels tired despite the numbers.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells the story of friends whose skin got dry and ashy, asking him for a lotion fix.

His answer: no. His test for any lotion or cream - if the label says to call poison control if it's ingested, ask why it's safe to rub on your skin every day instead. Your skin absorbs it straight into your body.

His point: those ingredients act as hormone disruptors. He ties it to men on testosterone therapy whose blood levels test high, yet something strange happens when they tell their doctor how they actually feel.

What's actually in the lotion in your own bathroom cabinet?

#kevintrudeau #skincare #readthelabel #hormonehealth #wbdaily #healthtruth
